description: This Java source file defines the MyCloudProvider class, which extends Android's DocumentsProvider to manage and expose documents stored in a local directory as a cloud-like storage provider. It includes methods for querying roots, recent documents, search, opening, creating, deleting documents, and handling MIME types, with internal logic for managing a mock file storage.

classes.name: MyCloudProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of Android's DocumentsProvider that manages local files as a mock cloud storage, providing document querying, opening, creation, deletion, and search functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider, sets the base directory, and preloads dummy files.

methods.name: queryRoots
methods.description: Returns the root directory information for the document provider.

methods.name: queryRecentDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently modified documents under a specified root.

methods.name: querySearchDocuments
methods.description: Searches for documents matching a query string within a root directory.

methods.name: openDocumentThumbnail
methods.description: Provides a thumbnail for a document.

methods.name: queryDocument
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific document.

methods.name: queryChildDocuments
methods.description: Lists child documents of a directory.

methods.name: openDocument
methods.description: Opens a document for reading or writing.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document within a directory.

methods.name: getDocumentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of a document.
